name: What are the security risks of a sliding door that doesn't close properly?

mainEntity.name: What are the security risks of a sliding door that doesn't close properly?

acceptedAnswer.text: A sliding door that doesn't close properly creates significant security vulnerabilities. It may not latch or lock securely, making it easier for intruders to gain access. Even a small gap can be exploited. This compromises your home's safety and can also invalidate some home insurance policies in case of a break-in. Ensuring full closure is crucial for home security.
acceptedAnswer.description: A sliding door that doesn't close properly poses security risks by making your home vulnerable to intruders and can affect insurance coverage.
